items.title: Western Digital (WDC) Faces New China Barriers As Chip Selloff Deepens
items.summary: Chinese authorities have imposed new barriers on Western Digital’s Sandisk unit, adding fresh constraints on its China operations in 2026. These measures come as China ramps up state-backed initiatives and competitive efforts that weigh on foreign chipmakers’ supply chains and market access. The developments coincide with a wider chip sector selloff that has pushed the Nasdaq 100 into correction territory.
